articles.title: Efficacy and safety of upadacitinib in adults and adolescents for treatment of non-segmental vitiligo (Viti-Up): results of two phase 3 randomised controlled studies
articles.authors: Passeron T, Prajapati VH, Sivamani RK, Ezzedine K, van Geel N, Hamzavi I, Pandya AG, Rosmarin D, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Non-segmental vitiligo is an autoimmune inflammatory disease characterised by loss of melanocytes leading to skin depigmentation. No systemic therapies have been approved, and additional therapeutic options are needed. Here, we report the efficacy and safety of upadacitinib, a selective once-daily Janus kinase inhibitor, in adults and adolescents with non-segmental vitiligo.
abstract.textZh: 非區段性白癜風是一種自身免疫性炎症性疾病，其特徵是黑色素細胞喪失，導致皮膚脫色。尚未批準全身治療，需要額外的治療選項。在這裡，我們報告了upadacitinib （一種選擇性每日一次的Janus激酶抑制劑）在患有非區段性白癜風的成人和青少年中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Viti-Up includes two phase 3, global, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies conducted at 138 institutions in 18 countries in Asia, Europe, North America, and South America. Eligible patients were adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older with non-segmental vitiligo involving the face and body with a Facial Vitiligo Scoring Index (F-VASI) of 0·5 or greater and Total Vitiligo Area Scoring Index (T-VASI) of 5 to less than 50. Patients were randomly assigned (2:1) to receive either upadacitinib 15 mg or placebo orally once daily. The coprimary efficacy endpoints for both studies were T-VASI 50 (≥50% reduction in T-VASI score from baseline) at week 48 and F-VASI 75 (≥75% reduction in F-VASI score from baseline) at week 48 (ie, clinically meaningful repigmentation). Efficacy endpoints were analysed in the intention-to-treat population; safety endpoints were assessed in all randomly assigned patients who received at least one dose of study drug during the 48-week double-blind period. Viti-Up is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06118411, and is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: Viti-Up包括在亞洲、歐洲、北美和南美18個國家的138個機構進行的兩項3期研究，即全球、多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照研究。 符合資格的患者是面部和身體非區段性白癜風的成人和12歲或以上的青少年，面部白癜風評分指數（ F-VASI ）為0.5或以上，總白癜風面積評分指數（ T-VASI ）為5至小於50。 患者被隨機分配(2: 1)為每天一次口服15 mg upadacitinib或安慰劑。 兩項研究的共同主要療效終點為第48週的T-VASI 50 （ T-VASI評分較基線減少≥ 50% ）和第48週的F-VASI 75 （ F-VASI評分較基線減少≥ 75% ） （即，有臨牀意義的重新色素沉著）。 在意向治療族羣中分析有效性終點；在48週雙盲期間接受至少一劑研究藥物的所有隨機分配的患者中評估安全性終點。 Viti-Up已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT06118411 ）上註冊，並且正在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 19, 2023, and Oct 14, 2024, 750 individuals were assessed for eligibility. 308 individuals in Viti-Up-1 (206 assigned to upadacitinib and 102 assigned to placebo; 156 [51%] female and 152 [49%] male) and 306 in Viti-Up-2 (205 assigned to upadacitinib and 101 assigned to placebo; 151 [49%] female and 155 [51%] male) were randomly assigned. At week 48, a greater proportion receiving upadacitinib versus placebo reached the coprimary endpoints of T-VASI 50 (Viti-Up-1: upadacitinib 40 [19%] participants vs placebo six [6%]; Viti-Up-2: upadacitinib 44 [21%] vs placebo six [6%]; p<0·001) and F-VASI 75 (Viti-Up-1: upadacitinib 52 [25%] vs placebo six [6%]; Viti-Up-2: upadacitinib 48 [23%] vs placebo seven [7%]; p<0·001). There were no reports of adjudicated major adverse cardiovascular events, adjudicated venous thromboembolic events, adjudicated gastrointestinal perforations, active tuberculosis, lymphoma, non-melanoma skin cancer, or opportunistic infections other than herpes zoster in either study. Safety data were consistent with the overall upadacitinib safety profile.
abstract.textZh: 在2023年12月19日至2024年10月14日期間，評估了750名個體的資格。隨機分配了Viti-Up-1的308名個體（ 206名分配給upadacitinib ， 102名分配給安慰劑； 156名[51%]女性和152名[49%]男性）和Viti-Up-2的306名個體（ 205名分配給upadacitinib ， 101名分配給安慰劑； 151名[49%]女性和155名[51%]男性）。 在第48週，接受upadacitinib相較於安慰劑達到T-VASI 50共同主要終點的比例較高（ Viti-Up-1 ： upadacitinib 40 [19%]參與者vs安慰劑6 [6%] ； Viti-Up-2 ： upadacitinib 44 [21%] vs安慰劑6 [6%] ； p < 0.001 ）和F-VASI 75 （ Viti-Up-1 ： upadacitinib 52 [25%] vs安慰劑6 [6%] ； Viti-Up-2 ： upadacitinib 48 [23%] vs安慰劑7 [7%] ； p < 0.001 ）。 在任何一項研究中，除帶狀皰疹外，均未報告已判定的重大心血管不良事件、已判定的靜脈血栓栓塞事件、已判定的胃腸穿孔、活動性結核病、淋巴瘤、非黑色素瘤皮膚癌或機會性感染。 安全性資料與整體upadacitinib安全性特徵一致。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Upadacitinib 15 mg daily provides clinically meaningful repigmentation of both the face and total body for adults and adolescents with non-segmental vitiligo, with no new safety signals identified.
abstract.textZh: Upadacitinib每日15毫克可為患有非區段性白癜風的成人和青少年提供具有臨牀意義的面部和全身色素重組，但未發現新的安全性信號。

articles.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide, a novel unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist, in type 2 diabetes: a multicentre, randomised, parallel, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-finding, phase 2 trial
articles.authors: Mora P, Aroda VR, Asong M, Blüher M, Heftdal LD, Carlander AF, Vilsen LN, Rosenstock J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Zenagamtide (formerly amycretin) is a unimolecular agonist of GLP-1, amylin, and calcitonin receptors. We aimed to investigate the dose-response relationship with respect to the efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide compared with placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes.
abstract.textZh: Zenagamtide （以前稱爲amycretin ）是GLP-1、澱粉和降鈣素受體的單分子激動劑。我們的目的是研究每週一次的皮下zenagamtide與安慰劑在成人2型糖尿病患者中的有效性和安全性之間的劑量反應關係。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This 36-week, randomised, parallel, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-finding, phase 2 trial was conducted at 83 hospital and clinic sites across 11 countries. The trial consisted of a 3-week screening period, a 36-week intervention period, and a 4-week follow-up period. Adults (aged 18-75 years) with type 2 diabetes (glycated haemoglobin [HbA1c] 7·0-10·0% [53-86 mmol/mol]), treated with stable doses of metformin with or without a SGLT2 inhibitor, and with a BMI of 23·0 to <50·0 kg/m2 were randomly assigned (6:1) to once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide or placebo using a randomisation and trial supplies management system, before being further randomly assigned to one of six dose groups (1:1:1:1:1:1; 0·4, 1·5, 5, 10, 20, or 40 mg). Participants assigned to placebo were similarly allocated to matched placebo regimens corresponding to each dosing schedule. Randomisation was stratified by HbA1c (<8·5% or ≥8·5%) at screening and country of residence (Japan or other countries). The starting dose of subcutaneous zenagamtide was 0·2 mg, with dose escalations every 4 weeks until the maintenance dose was reached (0·4-40 mg). Participants and staff were masked within each dose level to placebo or zenagamtide. The primary outcome was change in HbA1c from baseline to week 36. The primary outcome was assessed in all randomly assigned participants using the efficacy estimand based on on-treatment data without rescue medication. Safety outcomes were assessed in all randomly assigned participants exposed to treatment. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06542874, and is completed.
abstract.textZh: 這項為期36週的隨機、平行、雙盲、安慰劑對照、劑量尋找、2期試驗在11個國家的83個醫院和診所進行。 試驗包括3週的篩選期、36週的幹預期和4週的隨訪期。 成人（ 18-75歲）患有2型糖尿病（糖化血紅蛋白[HbA1c] 7 · 0-10 · 0% [53-86 mmol/mol] ） ，使用穩定劑量的二甲雙胍加或不加SGLT2抑制劑， BMI為23 · 0至< 50 · 0 kg/m2 ，使用隨機分配和試驗用品管理系統隨機分配（ 6 ： 1 ）至每週一次的皮下zenagamtide或安慰劑，然後再隨機分配至六個劑量組（ 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ； 0 · 4 ， 1 · 5 ， 5 ， 10 ， 20或40 mg ）之一。 分配給安慰劑的參與者同樣被分配到對應於每個劑量計劃的匹配安慰劑方案。 在篩選和居住國家/地區（日本或其他國家/地區）根據HbA1c （ < 8.5 ％或≥ 8.5 ％ ）進行隨機分層。 皮下zenagamtide的起始劑量為0.2mg ，劑量每4週增加一次，直到達到維持劑量(0.4-40mg)。 參與者和工作人員在每個劑量水平內被安慰劑或zenagamtide遮罩。 主要結果是HbA1c從基線到第36週的變化。 在所有隨機分配的參與者中，根據治療期數據使用療效估計和評估主要結果，而無需救援藥物。 隨機評估所有患者的安全性結果

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Aug 7 and Dec 27, 2024, 262 (29%) of 915 screened individuals were randomly assigned to subcutaneous zenagamtide (n=225) or placebo (n=37). Participants were further randomly assigned (1:1:1:1:1:1) to one of six doses (38 participants to 0·4 mg, 36 participants to 1·5 mg, 37 participants to 5 mg, 38 participants to 10 mg, 38 participants to 20 mg, and 38 participants to 40 mg) or placebo (37 participants). 261 participants were exposed to treatment. At week 36, estimated change in HbA1c (mean across all groups at baseline 7·8% [SD 0·8]) ranged from -0·9% with zenagamtide 0·4 mg (estimated treatment difference vs placebo: -0·77% [95% CI -1·26 to -0·28]; p=0·0021) to -1·7% with zenagamtide 40 mg (-1·56% [-2·05 to -1·07]; p<0·0001). Most adverse events were gastrointestinal and mild to moderate in severity. 21 (8%) of 261 participants reported serious adverse events (four with zenagamtide 0·4 mg, three with 1·5 mg, two with 5 mg, five with 10 mg, three with 20 mg, one with 40 mg, and three with placebo). No deaths occurred.
abstract.textZh: 在2024年8月7日至12月27日期間， 915名篩選個體中的262名（ 29% ）被隨機分配到皮下zenagamtide （ n = 225 ）或安慰劑（ n = 37 ）。 將參與者進一步隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ： 1 ）至六種劑量（ 38名參與者為0.4mg ， 36名參與者為1.5mg ， 37名參與者為5mg ， 38名參與者為10mg ， 38名參與者為20mg ， 38名參與者為40mg ）或安慰劑（ 37名參與者）中的一種。261名參與者暴露於治療。 在第36週， HbA1c的估計變化（基線7 · 8% [SD 0 · 8]時所有組的平均值）範圍從-0 · 9% （ zenagamtide 0 · 4 mg ） （與安慰劑的估計治療差異： -0 · 77% [95% CI -1 · 26至-0 · 28] ； p = 0 · 0021 ）到-1 · 7% （ zenagamtide 40 mg ） （ -1 · 56% [-2 · 05至-1 · 07] ； p < 0 · 0001 ）。 大多數不良事件為胃腸道不良事件，嚴重程度為輕度至中度。261名參與者中有21名（ 8 ％ ）報告了嚴重不良事件（ 4名服用zenagamtide 0.4 mg ， 3名服用1.5 mg ， 2名服用5 mg ， 5名服用10 mg ， 3名服用20 mg ， 1名服用40 mg ， 3名服用安慰劑）。未發生死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In people with type 2 diabetes, once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide 0·4-40 mg demonstrated clinically meaningful and significant improvements in change in HbA1c from baseline to week 36 compared with placebo, with a safety and tolerability profile consistent with that of other GLP-1-based and amylin-based therapies.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Aug 7 and Dec 27, 2024, 186 (20%) of 915 screened participants were randomly assigned to oral zenagamtide (54 participants to 6 mg, 51 participants to 25 mg, and 51 participants to 50 mg) or placebo (30 participants) and were included in the full analysis set. articles.title: Retroperitoneal fibrosis
articles.authors: Vaglio A, Peyronel F, Bajema IM, Pegoraro F

abstract.text: Retroperitoneal fibrosis is a rare immune-mediated disease characterised by a periaortoiliac fibro-inflammatory tissue that often encases neighbouring structures (eg, ureters). Idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis can be isolated or part of IgG4-related disease, whereas secondary forms recognise different aetiologies, such as histiocytosis, malignancies, and infections. Idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis has a multifactorial origin, with genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors being main contributors. The immunopathogenesis of the disease involves B-lymphocyte and T-lymphocyte crosstalk, macrophage and fibrocyte chemotaxis, and recruitment of eosinophils and mast cells. Idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis can cause severe complications, such as acute or chronic kidney injury, caval occlusion, and deep vein thrombosis. Although interventional or surgical procedures can be necessary to manage these complications, medical therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment. Glucocorticoids are effective, and B-cell-targeting therapies are increasingly used. However, relapses are frequent after treatment discontinuation. In this Seminar, we provide a contemporary overview of retroperitoneal fibrosis focusing on pathophysiology, differential diagnosis, and management.

articles.title: Evidence-Based Tobacco-Cessation Strategies for Low- and Middle-Income Countries
articles.authors: Shelley D, Rigotti NA, Murthy P, Van Minh H, Siddiqi K

abstract.text: Tobacco use is the leading cause of preventable death globally, claiming more than 7 million lives each year. The burden of disease is highest in low- and middle-income countries, where more than 80% of the world's 1.3 billion tobacco users reside. The World Health Organization (WHO) defines six proven strategies to reduce tobacco use, referred to by the acronym MPOWER, with one of the strategies being to offer tobacco users help with quitting. Many low- and middle-income countries provide tobacco-cessation services; however, only 31 meet the WHO best practice, defined as providing both cost-covered behavioral interventions and pharmacotherapy. In this article, case studies from India and Vietnam illustrate how cross-country differences in tobacco-related sociocultural norms, tobacco-use patterns (e.g., smokeless tobacco or water pipes), the tobacco-control regulatory environment, industry influence, and health care system financing shape treatment access and uptake. These cases further show that cost-effective population-level strategies, including quitlines, digital interventions, and systemwide screening for tobacco use paired with clinician advice to quit, are essential for expanding treatment reach. Combining these interventions with pharmacotherapy products that are included on the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines (e.g., cytisine and nicotine-replacement therapy) further improves cessation outcomes. System-level models, such as the Ask-Advise-Connect model (ask about tobacco use, advise to quit, connect to cessation help), offer a feasible, low-burden pathway for integrating cessation care into routine practice. Ultimately, curbing the rising global burden of tobacco-related disease requires establishing comprehensive cessation support as a universal standard of care, which would ensure equitable access for those most affected.

articles.title: Talquetamab-Daratumumab in Relapsed or Refractory Myeloma
articles.authors: Mina R, Beksac M, Rodríguez-Otero P, Chen W, Mateos MV, Li J, Moreau P, Cohen YC, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Talquetamab, a bispecific antibody targeting GPRC5D and CD3, has led to durable responses in patients with heavily pretreated relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma in phase 1-2 trials, with a limited effect on normal B cells.
abstract.textZh: Talquetamab是一種靶向GPRC5D和CD3的雙特異性抗體，在1-2期試驗中，在嚴重預治復發或難治性多發性骨髓瘤患者中導致持久反應，對正常B細胞的影響有限。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a phase 3 trial, we randomly assigned patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who had previously received at least one line of therapy to receive talquetamab plus daratumumab and pomalidomide (Tal-DP), talquetamab plus daratumumab (Tal-D), or daratumumab plus pomalidomide and dexamethasone (DPd). The primary end point was progression-free survival as assessed by an independent review committee. Key secondary end points were overall response, complete response or better (complete or stringent complete response), measurable residual disease-negative complete response, and overall survival.
abstract.textZh: 在一項3期試驗中，我們將先前接受過至少一線治療的復發性或難治性多發性骨髓瘤患者隨機分配接受talquetamab加daratumumab和泊馬度胺(Tal-DP)、talquetamab加daratumumab (Tal-D)或daratumumab加泊馬度胺和地塞米鬆(DPd)。主要終點為由獨立審查委員會評估的無惡化生存期。關鍵次要終點是總體緩解、完全緩解或更佳（完全或嚴格完全緩解）、可測量的殘留疾病陰性完全緩解和總生存期。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 287, 287, and 290 patients were assigned to the Tal-DP, Tal-D, and DPd groups, respectively. At the interim analysis (median follow-up, 24.6 months), progression-free survival was significantly longer with Tal-DP and Tal-D than with DPd (24-month estimate, 81.3% and 77.6% vs. 51.2%; hazard ratio for disease progression or death, Tal-DP vs. DPd, 0.28 [95% confidence interval {CI}, 0.20 to 0.40], and Tal-D vs. DPd, 0.33 [95% CI, 0.24 to 0.46]; P<0.001 for both comparisons). The overall response was higher with Tal-DP and Tal-D than with DPd (88.2% and 88.5% vs. 77.6%), as was complete response or better (71.1% and 69.0% vs. 34.5%) and measurable residual disease-negative complete response (52.3% and 46.3% vs. 15.9%) (P<0.001 for all comparisons). Overall survival at 24 months was 89.2% with Tal-DP, 87.9% with Tal-D, and 79.1% with DPd (hazard ratio for death, Tal-DP vs. DPd, 0.47 [95% CI, 0.30 to 0.73], and Tal-D vs. DPd, 0.51 [95% CI, 0.33 to 0.78]). Serious adverse events occurred in 63.0%, 52.6%, and 53.7% of the patients in the Tal-DP, Tal-D, and DPd groups, respectively; fatal adverse events occurred in 1.8%, 4.0%, and 4.6%.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who had previously received at least one line of therapy, both Tal-DP and Tal-D led to significantly longer progression-free survival than DPd. (Funded by Johnson & Johnson; MonumenTAL-3 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05455320.).

articles.title: Phase 3 Trial of Secukinumab in Polymyalgia Rheumatica
articles.authors: Stone JH, Buttgereit F, Saraux A, Schmidt WA, Dejaco C, Spiera R, Dasgupta B, Drescher E, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Polymyalgia rheumatica is a common inflammatory disease characterized by pain and stiffness in the shoulders and hips. Glucocorticoids are the first-line treatment, but relapses and glucocorticoid-related toxic effects are common, which underscores the need for effective alternatives. Secukinumab is a fully human monoclonal antibody that selectively inhibits interleukin-17A.
abstract.textZh: 風濕性多肌痛是一種常見的炎症性疾病，其特徵是肩膀和臀部疼痛和僵硬。糖皮質激素是第一線治療，但復發和糖皮質激素相關的毒性作用很常見，這強調了有效替代品的必要性。蘇金單抗是一種選擇性抑制白介素-17A的全人類單株抗體。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We enrolled patients with recently relapsed polymyalgia rheumatica and randomly assigned them, in a 1:1:1 ratio, to receive secukinumab at a dose of 300 mg (SEC-300 group), secukinumab at a dose of 150 mg (SEC-150 group), or placebo for 52 weeks. Patients in all the groups also received prednisone on a tapering schedule for 24 weeks. The primary outcome was sustained remission at week 52, defined as remission (the absence of signs or symptoms attributable to polymyalgia rheumatica and no new diagnosis of giant-cell arteritis that warranted escape or rescue treatment) that was sustained from week 12 until week 52. The annual cumulative glucocorticoid dose was a secondary outcome. Safety was also assessed.
abstract.textZh: 我們招募了最近復發的多肌痛風濕病患者，並以1: 1: 1的比例隨機分配他們接受300 mg劑量的蘇金單抗（ SEC-300組）、150 mg劑量的蘇金單抗（ SEC-150組）或安慰劑52週。所有組別的患者也接受了為期24週的漸減強的鬆治療。主要結果為第52週的持續緩解，定義為從第12週持續至第52週的緩解（沒有風濕性肌痛徵兆或症狀，且沒有新的巨細胞動脈炎診斷需要逃脫或救援治療）。年度累積糖皮質激素劑量是次要結果。也評估了安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 381 patients underwent randomization, and 127 were assigned to each group. At 52 weeks, sustained remission was observed in 41.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], 32.8 to 49.7) of the patients in the SEC-300 group, in 40.6% (95% CI, 32.2 to 49.0) of those in the SEC-150 group, and in 20.4% (95% CI, 13.6 to 27.2) of those in the placebo group (P<0.001 for the comparison of each secukinumab dose with placebo). The mean adjusted annual cumulative glucocorticoid dose was 1603.7 mg in the SEC-300 group, 1683.2 mg in the SEC-150 group, and 2093.0 mg in the placebo group. Serious adverse events occurred in 13.5% of the patients in the SEC-300 group, in 15.9% in the SEC-150 group, and in 14.2% in the placebo group. Nasopharyngitis, hypersensitivity reactions, urinary tract infections, fungal infections, and back pain were more common in the secukinumab groups than in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 共有381名患者接受隨機分組，每組分配127名患者。在52週時， SEC-300組中41.2% (95%可信區間[CI] ， 32.8至49.7)的患者、SEC-150組中40.6% (95% CI ， 32.2至49.0)的患者和安慰劑組中20.4% (95% CI ， 13.6至27.2)的患者中觀察到持續緩解(每個蘇金單抗劑量與安慰劑的比較P < 0.001)。SEC-300組的平均調整年度累積糖皮質激素劑量為1603.7 mg ， SEC-150組為1683.2 mg ，安慰劑組為2093.0 mg。SEC-300組中13.5%的患者發生嚴重不良事件， SEC-150組中15.9%的患者發生嚴重不良事件，安慰劑組中14.2%的患者發生嚴重不良事件。鼻咽炎、超敏反應、尿路感染、真菌感染和背痛在蘇金單抗組中比在安慰劑組中更常見。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with relapsed polymyalgia rheumatica, treatment with secukinumab plus a 24-week glucocorticoid taper resulted in a higher percentage of patients with remission and in lower cumulative glucocorticoid doses than a glucocorticoid taper alone. (Funded by Novartis; REPLENISH ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05767034.).
abstract.textZh: 在復發性多肌痛風濕病患者中，蘇金單抗加24週糖皮質激素漸減治療導致緩解的患者百分比較高，累積糖皮質激素劑量低於單獨使用糖皮質激素漸減治療。（由諾華公司資助；補充ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05767034。）

articles.title: Selpercatinib in Early-Stage RET Fusion-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
articles.authors: Wu YL, Hochmair M, Yang Y, Yang XN, Tsuboi M, Paz-Ares L, Yang JC, Wu L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Selpercatinib, a highly selective, potent, and central nervous system-penetrant RET inhibitor, is approved for RET fusion-positive advanced or metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The efficacy and safety of selpercatinib in early-stage NSCLC are unknown.
abstract.textZh: Selpercatinib是一種高度選擇性、強效和中樞神經系統穿透性RET抑製劑，已被批準用於RET融合陽性晚期或轉移性非小細胞肺癌（ NSCLC ）。selpercatinib在早期NSCLC中的有效性和安全性尚不清楚。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a phase 3, double-blind trial involving patients with RET fusion-positive NSCLC who had received definitive therapy with curative intent (surgery or radiotherapy with adjuvant systemic anticancer therapy, if applicable). Patients were randomly assigned to receive adjuvant selpercatinib or placebo for up to 3 years. The primary end point was investigator-assessed event-free survival in patients with stage II or IIIA disease. Secondary end points were investigator-assessed event-free survival in patients with stage IB, II, or IIIA disease; event-free survival as assessed by blinded independent central review; overall survival; and safety.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了一項3期雙盲試驗，涉及RET融合陽性NSCLC患者，他們接受了具有治療意圖的確切治療（手術或放射治療加輔助全身性抗癌治療，如適用）。患者被隨機分配接受輔助selpercatinib或安慰劑長達3年。主要終點是研究者評估的II期或IIIA期疾病患者的無事件生存期。次要終點是研究者評估的IB、II或IIIA期疾病患者的無事件生存期；由盲法獨立中央審查評估的無事件生存期；總生存期；和安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 151 patients were assigned to receive selpercatinib (75 patients) or placebo (76 patients). Median follow-up was 24 months and 27 months in the respective groups. Among 109 patients with stage II or IIIA disease, 2-year investigator-assessed event-free survival was 92% with selpercatinib and 61% with placebo (hazard ratio for disease recurrence, progression, or death, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.06 to 0.51; P<0.001). Event-free survival as assessed by blinded independent central review was consistent with investigator-assessed event-free survival. Among the 151 patients with stage IB, II, or IIIA NSCLC, investigator-assessed event-free survival at 2 years was 94% with selpercatinib and 70% with placebo (hazard ratio for disease recurrence, progression, or death, 0.16; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.48; P<0.001). The most common adverse events during the treatment period were increased levels of alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase (grade ≥3 in 17% and 19% of patients, respectively, in the selpercatinib group). Three deaths occurred, all in the placebo group, owing to disease progression.
abstract.textZh: 共有151名患者被分配接受selpercatinib （ 75名患者）或安慰劑（ 76名患者）。 各組的中位隨訪時間分別為24個月和27個月。 在109名II期或IIIA期疾病患者中，研究者評估的2年無事件生存率selpercatinib為92% ，安慰劑為61% （疾病復發、惡化或死亡的風險比為0.17 ； 95%可信區間[CI]為0.06至0.51 ； P < 0.001 ）。 通過盲法獨立中心審查評估的無事件生存期與試驗主持人評估的無事件生存期一致。 在151名IB、II或IIIA期NSCLC患者中，研究者評估的2年無事件生存率selpercatinib為94% ，安慰劑為70% （疾病復發、惡化或死亡的風險比為0.16 ； 95% CI為0.06至0.48 ； P < 0.001 ）。 治療期間最常見的不良事件是丙氨酸氨基轉移酶和天冬氨酸氨基轉移酶的水平升高（在selpercatinib組中， 17%和19%的患者分別為≥ 3級）。 由於疾病進展，在安慰劑組中發生了三例死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with stage II or IIIA RET fusion-positive NSCLC, event-free survival was significantly longer with adjuvant selpercatinib than with placebo. (Funded by Lilly; LIBRETTO-432 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04819100.).
abstract.textZh: 在II期或IIIA期RET融合陽性NSCLC患者中，輔助selpercatinib的無事件生存期明顯長於安慰劑。（由Lilly資助； LIBRETTO-432 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT04819100。）。

articles.title: In Vivo Base Editing of PCSK9 with VERVE-102 for Hypercholesterolemia
articles.authors: Vafai SB, Täubel J, Ashdown T, Patel RS, Diamondali S, Cegla J, Soran H, Bashir B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Persons carrying loss-of-function variants of proprotein convertase subtilisin-kexin type 9 (PCSK9) have reduced levels of low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol and fewer atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease events than persons without such variants. VERVE-102 is an investigational base-editing therapy designed to durably inactivate PCSK9 in the liver.
abstract.textZh: 攜帶9型前蛋白轉化酶枯草杆菌蛋白酶(PCSK9)功能喪失變異體的人與沒有這種變異體的人相比，低密度脂蛋白(LDL)膽固醇水平降低，動脈粥樣硬化性心血管疾病事件減少。VERVE-102是一種試驗性鹼基編輯療法，旨在使肝臟中的PCSK9持久失活。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 1, open-label, single-ascending-dose study, we administered one intravenous infusion of VERVE-102 at one of six doses (ranging from 0.3 to 1.0 mg of total RNA per kilogram of body weight [mg per kilogram]) to adults with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia or premature coronary artery disease. VERVE-102 consists of a messenger RNA encoding an adenine base-editor protein and a guide RNA targeting PCSK9, which are encapsulated in a lipid nanoparticle incorporating N-acetylgalactosamine. The objectives were to assess safety and changes in blood PCSK9 protein and LDL cholesterol levels.
abstract.textZh: 在這項1期、開放標籤、單次提升劑量的研究中，我們以六種劑量（範圍為每公斤體重0.3至1.0毫克總RNA [mg/kg] ）中的一種靜脈輸注VERVE-102給患有雜合子家族性高膽固醇血症或冠狀動脈早發病的成人。VERVE-102由編碼腺嘌呤鹼基編輯蛋白質的信使RNA和靶向PCSK9的引導RNA組成，其封裝在包含N-乙酰半乳糖胺的脂質納米粒中。目的是評估血液中PCSK9蛋白和LDL膽固醇水平的安全性和變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 35 participants across the six dose cohorts received VERVE-102 and had at least 28 days of follow-up. No dose-limiting toxic effects occurred. Mild-to-moderate infusion-related reactions and transient elevations in alanine aminotransferase levels were observed. Aspiration pneumonitis occurred in a participant with gastroesophageal reflux disease. Dose-dependent mean reductions in the PCSK9 level ranged from 51% at the 0.3-mg-per-kilogram dose to 88% at the 1.0-mg-per-kilogram dose. Corresponding reductions in the LDL cholesterol level ranged from 9% at the 0.3-mg-per-kilogram dose to 62% at the 1.0-mg-per-kilogram dose, with an absolute reduction of 78 mg per deciliter at the highest dose. Reductions appeared to be durable throughout follow-up, which was at least 1 year in 15 participants.
abstract.textZh: 六個劑量羣組中共有35名參與者接受了VERVE-102 ，並進行了至少28天的隨訪。未發生劑量限制性毒性作用。觀察到丙氨酸氨基轉移酶水平的輕度至中度輸注相關反應和短暫升高。吸入性肺炎發生在患有胃食管反流病的參與者身上。PCSK9水平的劑量依賴性平均降低範圍從每公斤劑量0.3毫克時的51%到每公斤劑量1.0毫克時的88%。LDL膽固醇水平的相應降低範圍從每公斤劑量0.3毫克時的9%到每公斤劑量1.0毫克時的62% ，最高劑量時的絕對降低為每分升78毫克。在整個追蹤期間，減量似乎是持久的，在15名參與者中至少是1年。

articles.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer: A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Ellis RJ, Pugh SL, Yu JB, Feng FY, Konski AA, Grubb RL, Wallace RE, Gladstone DJ, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: The treatment of prostate cancer with radiotherapy is evolving. How quickly radiotherapy can be delivered, and the relative risks and benefits of such a treatment, is of significant public interest.
abstract.textZh: 放射治療前列腺癌的治療正在發展。放射治療能夠以多快的速度進行，以及這種治療的相對風險和益處，具有重大的公眾利益。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) was superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy (MH-IMRT) in terms of patient-reported urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival (DFS).
abstract.textZh: 確定立體定向身體放射治療（ SBRT ）在患者報告的尿路刺激性/阻塞性和腸道生活質量和無病生存（ DFS ）方面是否優於中度低分割強度調節放射治療（ MH-IMRT ）。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: NRG-GU005 was a phase-3, international, open-label, randomized clinical trial. The study was activated on November 16, 2017, and closed to accrual on June 8, 2022. Date of last follow-up was October 13, 2024. There were 136 centers in Asia, Canada, Europe, and the United States that accrued patients to the study. Patients with localized prostate cancer, clinical stage T1-T2b with Gleason 3 + 4 (grade group 2) and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) level less than 20 ng/mL or Gleason 3 + 3 (grade group 1) and PSA level 10 to 20 ng/mL were eligible. Intended accrual of 692 patients provided reductions of 8% and 10% in minimal clinically important decline (MCID) frequency for urinary-irritative/obstructive and bowel domains of the Expanded Prostate Cancer Index Composite-26 Item (EPIC-26) instrument at 2 years and greater than 80% power to detect a hazard ratio of 0.62 in DFS.
abstract.textZh: NRG-GU005是一項3期、國際、開放標籤、隨機臨牀試驗。該研究於2017年11月16日啟動，並於2022年6月8日結束累計。最後一次追蹤日期為2024年10月13日。在亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和美國，有136個中心累積患者參與研究。患有局限性前列腺癌、臨牀分期T1-T2b且Gleason 3 + 4 （第2級）和前列腺特異性抗原（ PSA ）水平低於20 ng/mL或Gleason 3 + 3 （第1級）和PSA水平為10至20 ng/mL的患者符合資格。692名患者的預期累積在2年內使擴大前列腺癌指數綜合26項（ EPIC-26 ）儀器的尿路刺激性/阻塞性和腸道域的臨牀重要性下降（ MCID ）頻率降低了8 ％和10 ％ ，並且在DFS中檢測風險比率大於80 ％。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomized 1:1 to receive SBRT (36.25 Gy in 5 fractions; n = 353) or MH-IMRT (70 Gy in 28 fractions or 60 Gy in 20 fractions; n  =345).
abstract.textZh: 患者以1: 1的比例隨機接受SBRT （ 5次分割36.25 Gy ； n = 353 ）或MH-IMRT （ 28次分割70 Gy或20次分割60 Gy ； n = 345 ）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Primary outcomes were the frequency of an MCID in the urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel domains of the EPIC-26 at 2 years and DFS at 3 years.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是2年時EPIC-26和3年時DFS的尿中刺激性/阻塞性和腸域中MCID的頻率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 698 patients were randomized. Median age was 68 years; 3% were Asian, 13% Black, and 80% White. Median follow-up was 3.2 years (range, 0-6.5). At 2 years, there was no significant difference in the urinary-irritative domain (35.4% vs 33.7%, P = .68). Urinary incontinence at 1 and 2 years after treatment and sexual function at 1 year after treatment favored SBRT. Fewer grade 3 + 4 genitourinary adverse events occurred in the SBRT vs MH-IMRT group (0.6% vs 2.5%, P = .04). There were significantly fewer MCIDs with SBRT vs MH-IMRT in the bowel domain (34.9% vs 43.8%, P = .03). At 3 years, DFS for MH-IMRT was 92.1% (95% CI, 88.9%-95.2%) vs 88.6% for SBRT (95% CI, 85.2%-92.1%) (1-sided log-rank P < .001).
abstract.textZh: 共有698名患者被隨機分組。中位年齡為68歲； 3%為亞裔， 13%為黑人， 80%為白人。中位隨訪時間為3.2年（範圍為0-6.5 ）。在2年時，尿刺激性領域沒有顯著差異（ 35.4%對33.7% ， P = 0.68 ）。治療後1年和2年的尿失禁和治療後1年的性功能均有利於SBRT。與MH-IMRT組相比， SBRT組發生的3 + 4級泌尿生殖系不良事件較少（ 0.6%對2.5% ， P = 0.04 ）。在腸域使用SBRT的MCID顯著少於MH-IMRT （ 34.9%對43.8% ， P = 0.03 ）。3年時， MH-IMRT的DFS爲92.1% （ 95% CI ， 88.9% -95.2% ） ， SBRT爲88.6% （ 95% CI ， 85.2% -92.1% ） （單側對數秩P < 0.001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Stereotactic body radiotherapy using a modest dose prescription improved multiple quality-of-life domains but was not superior to MH-IMRT in terms of DFS. The rate of PSA failure was not significantly improved in the SBRT vs MH-IMRT group.
abstract.textZh: 使用適度劑量處方的立體定向身體放射治療改善了多個生活品質領域，但在DFS方面並不優於MH-IMRT。與MH-IMRT組相比， SBRT組的PSA失敗率沒有顯著改善。

articles.title: Belzutifan plus lenvatinib versus cabozantinib in patients with previously treated advanced renal cell carcinoma (LITESPARK-011): an open-label, randomised, controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Motzer RJ, McDermott R, Park SH, Burotto M, Iacovelli R, Verzoni E, Suárez C, Eto M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The identification of a clear standard of care for patients with advanced clear-cell renal cell carcinoma following anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy warrants study as an unmet need. We aimed to investigate belzutifan plus lenvatinib versus cabozantinib in participants with clear-cell renal cell carcinoma previously treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
abstract.textZh: 確定抗PD-1或抗PD-L1治療後晚期透明細胞腎癌患者的明確治療標準，值得作為未滿足的需求進行研究。我們的目的是在先前接受免疫檢查點抑制劑治療的透明細胞腎癌參與者中研究Belzutifan + Lenvatinib與Cabozantinib。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: LITESPARK-011 is a phase 3, open-label, randomised, active-controlled study conducted at 184 medical centres in 25 countries in Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America. Participants were aged 18 years or older with advanced unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic stage IV clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, with disease progression following anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy with or without previous VEGFR-tyrosine-kinase inhibitors. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive 120 mg belzutifan plus 20 mg lenvatinib (belzutifan-lenvatinib) or 60 mg cabozantinib orally once daily until disease progression or unacceptable adverse events occurred. Randomisation was done using a web-based interactive response system (block size four) and stratified by International Metastatic Renal-Cell Carcinoma Database Consortium prognostic score (0 vs 1-2 vs 3-6), line of previous immunotherapy (adjuvant, neoadjuvant-adjuvant, or first-line vs second-line), and geographical region (North America vs western Europe vs rest of the world). The dual primary endpoints were progression-free survival by masked independent central review and overall survival, assessed in all randomly assigned participants. Safety was assessed in all randomly assigned participants who received at least one dose of study treatment. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04586231, and has completed participant recruitment and is ongoing with treatment and follow-up.
abstract.textZh: LITESPARK-011是一項在亞洲、澳大利亞、歐洲、北美和南美25個國家的184個醫療中心進行的3期、開放標籤、隨機、主動對照研究。 參與者年齡為18歲或以上，患有晚期不可切除、局部晚期或轉移性IV期透明細胞腎癌，在使用或不使用既往VEGFR-酪氨酸激酶抑制劑的抗PD-1或抗PD-L1治療後疾病進展。 參與者被隨機分配(1: 1)接受120 mg Belzutifan加20 mg Lenvatinib (Belzutifan-lenvatinib)或60 mg Cabozantinib ，每天口服一次，直到發生疾病進展或不可接受的不良事件。 隨機分組使用基於網絡的互動反應系統（塊大小4 ） ，並根據國際轉移性腎癌數據庫聯盟預後評分（ 0 vs 1-2 vs 3-6 ）、既往免疫治療線（輔助、新輔助輔助或一線vs二線）和地理區域（北美vs西歐vs世界其他地區）進行分層。 雙重主要終點是所有隨機分配參與者中評估的蒙面獨立中心審查的無惡化生存期和總生存期。 在接受至少一劑研究治療的所有隨機分配參與者中評估安全性。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT04586231 ）註冊，已完成參與者招募，並正在進行治療和隨訪。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 5, 2021, and Sept 1, 2023, 955 individuals were screened for eligibility, 747 of whom were randomly assigned to belzutifan-lenvatinib (n=371) or cabozantinib (n=376). 565 (76%) participants were male and 182 (24%) were female; 651 (87%) were White (table 1). At second interim analysis (data cutoff April 9, 2025; median follow-up 29·0 months [IQR 23·7-34·9]), progression-free survival was significantly longer in the belzutifan-lenvatinib group compared with the cabozantinib group (median 14·8 months [95% CI 11·2-16·6] vs 10·7 months [9·2-11·1]; hazard ratio [HR] 0·70 [95% CI 0·59-0·84]; one-sided p<0·0001). Overall survival was not significantly different between the groups (median 34·9 months [95% CI 27·5-not reached] vs 27·6 months [24·0-31·4]; HR 0·85 [95% CI 0·68-1·05]; one-sided p=0·061). Grade 3 or worse treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 311 (84%) of 370 participants in the belzutifan-lenvatinib group and 307 (83%) of 371 participants in the cabozantinib group, most commonly hypertension in both groups (114 [31%] participants in the belzutifan-lenvatinib group and 107 [29%] in the cabozantinib group). Treatment-related adverse events led to two deaths in the belzutifan-lenvatinib group and one death in the cabozantinib group.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年3月5日至2023年9月1日期間，篩選了955名符合資格的個體，其中747名被隨機分配到belzutifan-lenvatinib （ n = 371 ）或cabozantinib （ n = 376 ）。565名（ 76% ）參與者為男性， 182名（ 24% ）為女性； 651名（ 87% ）為白人（表1 ）。 在第二次期中分析（數據截止日期為2025年4月9日；中位隨訪時間為29 · 0個月[IQR 23 · 7-34 · 9] ）時，與cabozantinib組相比， belzutifan-lenvatinib組的無惡化生存期顯著更長（中位14 · 8個月[95% CI 11 · 2-16 · 6]對比10 · 7個月[9 · 2-11 · 1] ；風險比[HR] 0 · 70 [95% CI 0 · 59-0 · 84] ；單側p < 0 · 0001 ）。 兩組之間的整體存活率沒有顯著差異（中位數34 · 9個月[95% CI 27 · 5-未達到]對比27 · 6個月[24 · 0-31 · 4] ； HR 0 · 85 [95% CI 0 · 68-1 · 05] ；單側p = 0 · 061 ）。 Belzutifan-lenvatinib組370名參與者中的311名（ 84% ）和cabozantinib組371名參與者中的307名（ 83% ）發生3級或更差的治療中出現的不良事件，最常見於兩組的高血壓（ Belzutifan-lenvatinib組114名[31%]參與者和cabozantinib組107名[29%] ）。 治療相關不良事件導致belzutifan-lenvatinib組2例死亡， cabozantinib組1例死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Belzutifan-lenvatinib represents a novel and efficacious treatment option. Although overall survival was not significantly different between the groups, belzutifan-lenvatinib might be a new standard of care for patients with advanced clear-cell renal cell carcinoma with disease progression after previous anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy. The safety profile of belzutifan-lenvatinib was consistent with those of the individual drugs.
abstract.textZh: Belzutifan-lenvatinib是一種新穎且有效的治療選擇。雖然兩組之間的整體存活率沒有顯著差異，但Belzutifan-lenvatinib可能是既往抗PD-1或抗PD-L1治療後疾病惡化的晚期透明細胞腎癌患者的新標準治療。Belzutifan-lenvatinib的安全性與個別藥物的安全性一致。

articles.title: Switch to once-weekly, single-tablet islatravir-lenacapavir from daily standard of care for HIV-1 (ISLEND-2): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, active-controlled, phase 3 non-inferiority trial
articles.authors: Colson AE, Kumar PN, Ruane PJ, Chetchotisakd P, Ratanasuwan W, Liberty A, Nahass RG, Arenas-Pinto A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Antiretroviral therapies with long dosing intervals have the potential to improve virological outcomes and treatment satisfaction for people with HIV-1. We report the primary endpoint results from week 48 of ISLEND-2, a phase 3 trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of switching to once-weekly oral islatravir-lenacapavir from daily oral standard of care in virologically suppressed adults with HIV-1.
abstract.textZh: 長劑量間隔的抗逆轉錄病毒療法有可能改善HIV-1患者的病毒學結果和治療滿意度。我們報告了ISLEND-2第48週的主要終點結果，這是一項3期試驗，評估在病毒學抑制的HIV-1成人患者中改用每日口服標準護理的每週一次口服islatravir-lenacapavir的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This randomised, open-label, active-controlled, phase 3 non-inferiority trial was conducted at 100 sites in 14 countries and territories. Eligible participants were adults (aged ≥18 years) with HIV-1 who had been virologically suppressed on daily oral standard-of-care treatment for at least 6 months and had no previous virological failure. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1), using interactive response technology and stratified by geographical region, antiretroviral class, and CD4+ T-cell count, to switch to the once-weekly, single-tablet oral regimen of islatravir (2 mg)-lenacapavir (300 mg) or to continue daily oral standard of care for at least 96 weeks. The primary endpoint was the proportion of participants with an HIV-1 RNA viral load of 50 copies per mL or higher at week 48 (as per the US Food and Drug Administration-defined Snapshot algorithm), with a non-inferiority margin of 4%, assessed in all randomly assigned participants who received any dose of the assigned treatment. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06630299, and is active but closed to new participants.
abstract.textZh: 這項隨機、開放標籤、活性對照、3期非劣效性試驗在14個國家和地區的100個研究中心進行。 符合資格的參與者是患有HIV-1的成年人（年齡≥ 18歲） ，他們在每日口服標準護理治療中受到病毒學抑制至少6個月，且之前沒有病毒學失敗。 參與者被隨機分配(1: 1) ，使用交互式反應技術，並按地理區域、抗逆轉錄病毒類別和CD4 + T細胞計數分層，切換到伊斯拉曲韋(2 mg) -來那卡帕韋(300 mg)每週一次的單片口服方案，或繼續每日口服標準護理至少96週。 主要終點是第48週時HIV-1 RNA病毒載量為每毫升50拷貝或更高的參與者比例（根據美國食品和藥物管理局定義的快照演算法） ，非劣效性邊際為4% ，在所有接受任何劑量分配治療的隨機分配參與者中進行評估。 本試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT06630299 ，目前有效，但不對新參與者開放。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From Oct 8, 2024, to April 30, 2025, 727 participants were screened, of whom 647 were eligible for the study, 634 were randomly assigned, and 626 received treatment: 314 with islatravir-lenacapavir and 312 with standard of care. Of 626 participants, 211 (34%) were female, 193 (31%) were Black, 119 (19%) were Asian, 123 (20%) were Hispanic or Latine, and 89 (14%) were aged 65 years or older. At baseline, 552 (88%) were on a single-tablet antiretroviral regimen and 478 (76%) were receiving regimens containing integrase strand transfer inhibitors. At week 48, one (0·3%) of 314 participants in the islatravir-lenacapavir group and four (1·3%) of 312 participants in the standard-of-care group had an HIV-1 RNA viral load of 50 copies per mL or higher (difference -1·0% [95·002% CI -3·0 to 1·1]), meeting the non-inferiority criteria. Treatment-related adverse events occurred in 58 (18%) of 314 participants in the islatravir-lenacapavir group and one (<1%) of 312 participants in the standard-of-care group. Two (1%) of 314 participants in the islatravir-lenacapavir group and one (<1%) of 312 participants in the standard-of-care group discontinued the study owing to adverse events, with adverse events of grade 3 or higher occurring in 24 (8%) and 28 (9%) participants and serious adverse events in 22 (7%) and 27 (9%) participants in the islatravir-lenacapavir group and standard-of-care group, respectively. There were three deaths: one in the islatravir-lenacapavir group and two in the standard-of-care group, none of which were considered treatment-related.
abstract.textZh: 從2024年10月8日至2025年4月30日，篩選了727名參與者，其中647人符合參與研究的資格， 634人被隨機分配， 626人接受了治療： 314人使用伊斯拉特拉韋-來那卡帕韋， 312人使用標準治療。 在626名參與者中， 211名（ 34 ％ ）為女性， 193名（ 31 ％ ）為黑人， 119名（ 19 ％ ）為亞裔， 123名（ 20 ％ ）為西班牙裔或拉丁裔， 89名（ 14 ％ ）為65歲或以上。 在基線時， 552 (88%)接受單片抗逆轉錄病毒治療， 478 (76%)接受含有整合酶鏈轉移抑制劑的治療。 在第48週， islatravir-lenacapavir組的314名參與者中有1名（ 0.3 ％ ）和標準護理組的312名參與者中有4名（ 1.3 ％ ）的HIV-1 RNA病毒載量為每毫升50拷貝或更高（差異為-1.0 ％ [95.002 ％ CI -3.0至1.1] ） ，符合非劣效性標準。 治療相關不良事件發生在islatravir-lenacapavir組314名參與者中的58名（ 18% ）和標準護理組312名參與者中的1名（ < 1% ）。 伊斯拉曲韋-來那卡帕韋組的314名參與者中有2名（ 1% ）和標準護理組的312名參與者中有1名（ < 1% ）因不良事件而停止研究，伊斯拉曲韋-來那卡帕韋組和標準護理組的24名（ 8% ）和28名（ 9% ）參與者分別發生3級或以上的不良事件， 22名（ 7% ）和27名（ 9% ）參與者分別發生嚴重不良事件。 有3人死亡： 1人死於Islatravir-Lenacapavir組， 2人死於Islatravir-Lenacapavir組。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Once-weekly islatravir-lenacapavir showed non-inferior efficacy to the standard of care and was generally well tolerated. Longer-term safety data will provide further valuable insights beyond the week 48 data presented here. Islatravir-lenacapavir has potential to be the first once-weekly complete oral single-tablet regimen for HIV-1 treatment.

articles.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Jhanji S, Booth K, Hiller L, Braun J, Dunn J, Eggleston L, Fenton-May L, Frempong S, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Older adults undergoing major noncardiac surgery experience substantial postoperative morbidity and health care use. The comparative effectiveness of total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) vs volatile-based inhalational anesthesia on recovery and safety remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 接受重大非心臟手術的老年人會在術後出現大量發病率和使用醫療保健。全靜脈麻醉（ TIVA ）與揮發性吸入麻醉在恢復和安全性方面的比較有效性仍然不確定。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVES
abstract.text: To determine whether TIVA improves days alive and at home at 30 days compared with inhalational anesthesia and to evaluate differences in patient-centered outcomes and recovery.
abstract.textZh: 確定與吸入麻醉相比， TIVA在30天內是否改善了存活天數和在家中的天數，並評估以患者為中心的結果和恢復的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Pragmatic, multicenter, open-label randomized clinical trial conducted in 49 UK National Health Service hospitals from January 2022 to April 2024 (final follow-up, October 2024) among patients aged 50 years or older scheduled for elective major noncardiac surgery.
abstract.textZh: 2022年1月至2024年4月在49家英國國民健康服務醫院進行的務實、多中心、開放標籤的隨機臨牀試驗（最終隨訪， 2024年10月） ，受試者年齡在50歲或以上，計劃進行選擇性重大非心臟手術。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive maintenance of general anesthesia with either TIVA (propofol infusion) (n = 1254) or volatile-based inhalational agents (n = 1254). All other perioperative care was at clinician discretion.
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分為1 ： 1 ，接受使用TIVA （丙泊酚輸注） （ n = 1254 ）或揮發性吸入劑（ n = 1254 ）的全身麻醉維持治療。所有其他圍手術期護理均由臨牀醫師自行決定。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was days alive and at home at 30 days. Secondary outcomes included days alive and at home at 90 days; mortality at 30 days, 90 days, and 6 months; Quality of Recovery-15 score at day 3; patient satisfaction (Bauer Patient Satisfaction Questionnaire) at day 1; delirium (4 As Test [4AT]) at day 3; unintentional awareness under anesthesia; and major postoperative complications within 30 days.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果為存活天數和30天在家。次要結果包括90天時的存活天數和在家天數； 30天、90天和6個月的死亡率；第3天時的恢復質量-15分數；第1天時的患者滿意度（ Bauer患者滿意度問卷） ；第3天時的精神錯亂（ 4 As Test [4AT] ） ；麻醉下的意外意識；以及30天內的重大術後併發症。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among the 2508 randomized participants, the mean age was 67 (SD, 8.9) years, and 55% were male. Characteristics were balanced across randomized groups. Days alive and at home at 30 days were similar between groups (mean, 22.5 [SD, 6.8] days vs 22.4 [SD, 6.6] days for TIVA vs inhalational anesthesia, respectively; incidence rate ratio, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.99-1.02; adjusted P = .68). There were no differences in days alive and at home at 90 days; mortality at 30 days, 90 days, or 6 months; or Quality of Recovery-15 score at day 3. Lower rates of thirst, hoarseness, and nausea and vomiting were reported in the TIVA group. Levels of delirium were similar between groups, with the majority (87.6%) having no delirium at day 3. Major complications occurred in 12.4% of patients overall, with no significant between-group differences. Two cases of certain or probable unintentional awareness under anesthesia were reported, both in the TIVA group.
abstract.textZh: 在2508名隨機參與者中，平均年齡為67 (SD ， 8.9)歲， 55%為男性。特徵在各隨機分組之間是平衡的。30天時的存活天數和在家天數在兩組之間相似（ TIVA與吸入性麻醉的平均天數分別為22.5 [SD ， 6.8]天與22.4 [SD ， 6.6]天；發生率比為1.00 ； 95% CI ， 0.99-1.02 ；調整後的P = 0.68 ）。第90天的存活天數和家中天數沒有差異；第30天、第90天或第6個月的死亡率沒有差異；或第3天的恢復品質-15評分沒有差異。TIVA組報告的口渴、嘶啞、噁心和嘔吐率較低。兩組之間的譫妄水平相似，大多數（ 87.6 ％ ）在第3天沒有譫妄。整體12.4%的患者發生重大併發症，組間無顯著差異。在TIVA組中都報告了兩例麻醉下某些或可能意外意識的病例。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Among older adults undergoing major noncardiac surgery, TIVA did not improve days alive and at home at 30 days compared with inhalational anesthesia.
abstract.textZh: 在接受重大非心臟手術的老年人中，與吸入麻醉相比， TIVA在30天內沒有改善生存和在家中的天數。

articles.authors: Yang Y, Shen CY, Cheng MC, Kang W, Au PCM, Yan VKC, Huang HK, Wong CK, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) are a safe and effective alternative to warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation and mitral stenosis (AF-MS) remains controversial.
abstract.textZh: 在心房顫動和二尖瓣狹窄（ AF-MS ）患者中，直接口服抗凝劑（ DOAC ）是否是華法林的安全有效替代品仍然存在爭議。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of DOACs versus warfarin in patients with AF-MS.
abstract.textZh: 評估DOAC與華法林在AF-MS患者中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Observational cohort study using target trial emulation.
abstract.textZh: 使用目標試驗模擬的觀察性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-wide insurance claims data in Taiwan.
abstract.textZh: 臺灣全民保險索償資料。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Patients diagnosed with AF-MS and prescribed either DOACs or warfarin between 1 January 2011 and 31 December 2021 were included in the study.
abstract.textZh: 在2011年1月1日至2021年12月31日期間被診斷出患有AF-MS並處方DOAC或華法林的患者被納入研究。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: DOACs or warfarin.
abstract.textZh: DOAC或華法林。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Absolute risk differences (RDs) and risk ratios (RRs) at 1 year and 5 years of follow-up for ischemic stroke, systemic embolism, composite stroke, myocardial infarction (MI), intracranial hemorrhage, gastrointestinal bleeding, bleeding at other critical sites, and all-cause death.
abstract.textZh: 對缺血性中風、全身性栓塞、複合性中風、心肌梗塞(MI)、顱內出血、胃腸道出血、其他關鍵部位出血和全因死亡進行1年和5年隨訪時的絕對風險差異(RD)和風險比率(RR)。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Compared with warfarin, DOACs were associated with an increased risk for ischemic stroke (RD, 4.97 percentage points [95% CI, 1.27 to 8.57 percentage points]; RR, 1.22 [CI, 1.05 to 1.41]) and composite stroke (RD, 5.56 percentage points [CI, 1.77 to 8.97 percentage points]; RR, 1.23 [CI, 1.07 to 1.42]) and a decreased risk for MI (RD, -1.61 percentage points [CI, -3.17 to -0.03 percentage points]; RR, 0.61 [CI, 0.37 to 0.99]) at the 1-year follow-up. Rivaroxaban increased the risk for ischemic stroke during both short- and long-term follow-up periods. The 2 groups did not differ in risks for bleeding or all-cause death.
abstract.textZh: 與華法林相比， DOAC在1年隨訪時與缺血性卒中風險增加（ RD ， 4.97個百分點[95% CI ， 1.27至8.57個百分點] ； RR ， 1.22 [CI ， 1.05至1.41] ）和複合性卒中風險增加（ RD ， 5.56個百分點[CI ， 1.77至8.97個百分點] ； RR ， 1.23 [CI ， 1.07至1.42] ）以及MI風險降低（ RD ， -1.61個百分點[CI ， -3.17至-0.03個百分點] ； RR ， 0.61 [CI ， 0.37至0.99] ）。利伐沙班在短期和長期隨訪期間增加了缺血性中風的風險。兩組在出血或全因死亡的風險方面沒有差異。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Limited sample size, lack of detailed information on MS severity, and lack of international normalized ratio measurements.
abstract.textZh: 樣本量有限、缺乏有關MS嚴重程度的詳細資訊，以及缺乏國際標準化比率測量。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: In Asian patients with AF-MS, DOACs were associated with an increased 1-year risk for stroke but a decreased risk for MI compared with warfarin.
abstract.textZh: 在患有AF-MS的亞洲患者中， DOAC與1年中風風險增加相關，但與華法林相比，心肌梗死的風險降低。

articles.title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
articles.authors: Park SK, Singh S

abstract.text: The global burden of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) continues to rise, placing increasing demands on primary care and specialty practices alike. Beyond disease control, patients with IBD face heightened risks related to chronic inflammation and long-term immunosuppressive therapy, including infection, cancer, bone loss, nutritional deficiencies, and mental health disorders. Proactive, structured health care maintenance encompassing vaccination, cancer screening, bone and cardiometabolic health, nutrition, and psychosocial well-being is essential to optimize long-term outcomes. Effective delivery of this care depends on close collaboration and clearly defined shared responsibilities between gastroenterologists and primary care physicians. This review outlines evidence-based strategies for health care maintenance in the outpatient management of adults with IBD.
abstract.textZh: 炎症性腸病（ IBD ）的全球負擔持續上升，對初級保健和專科診所的需求日益增加。除了疾病控制之外， IBD患者還面臨與慢性炎症和長期免疫抑制治療相關的風險增加，包括感染、癌症、骨質流失、營養缺乏和心理健康障礙。主動、結構化的醫療保健維護，包括疫苗接種、癌症篩查、骨骼和心臟代謝健康、營養和社會心理健康，對於優化長期結果至關重要。有效提供這種護理取決於腸胃科醫生和初級護理醫生之間的密切合作和明確定義的共同責任。本綜述概述了IBD成人門診管理中醫療保健維護的循證策略。

articles.title: Surgery Versus Watchful Waiting for First Metatarsophalangeal Joint Osteoarthritis : A Randomized Controlled Trial
articles.authors: Miettinen M, Sirola T, Lähdeoja T, Sandelin H, Nummela M, Repo JP, Ponkilainen V, Rämö L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Hallux rigidus, or osteoarthritis of the first metatarsophalangeal joint (MTPJ), causes pain and functional limitation. No randomized trials have compared surgery with the natural course of the disease.
abstract.textZh: 第一跖趾關節（ MTPJ ）的骨關節炎（ Hallux rigidus ）會導致疼痛和功能限制。沒有隨機試驗將手術與疾病的自然進程進行比較。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare first MTPJ arthrodesis-a widely used surgical intervention-with watchful waiting in reducing walking-related pain in symptomatic hallux rigidus at 12 months after randomization.
abstract.textZh: 為了比較第一次MTPJ關節融合術（廣泛使用的手術介入）與隨機分組後12個月時在減少症狀性大腸僵硬中行走相關疼痛的觀察性等待。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Single-center, parallel-group, randomized, controlled, superiority trial with 12-month follow-up. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT04590313).
abstract.textZh: 單中心、平行組、隨機、對照、優效性試驗， 12個月隨訪。（ ClinicalTrials.gov ： NCT04590313 ）。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Orthopedic department of a tertiary care hospital in Finland.
abstract.textZh: 芬蘭三級護理醫院的骨科。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Adults aged 40 years or older with radiographically confirmed (Coughlin-Shurnas grade I to III) hallux rigidus with symptoms over a year and a walking pain score of 4 or higher on a numerical rating scale (NRS) of 0 to 10 were eligible. Exclusion criteria included type 1 diabetes mellitus, rheumatoid arthritis, and hallux valgus angle greater than 15°.
abstract.textZh: 符合資格的有40歲或以上的成年人，經放射學確認（ Coughlin-Shurnas I至III級） ，症狀超過一年，行走疼痛評分為4或更高，數字評分量表（ NRS ）為0至10。排除標準包括1型糖尿病、類風濕性關節炎和外翻角大於15°。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to surgery with first MTPJ arthrodesis using lag-screw and dorsal plating or to watchful waiting.
abstract.textZh: 參與者以1 ： 1的比例被隨機分配到使用滯後螺絲和背板進行首次MTPJ關節整合的手術或觀察等待。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: The primary outcome was walking-related pain (NRS of 0 to 10) at 12 months. The prespecified minimal clinically important difference was 1.7 points.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是12個月時與行走相關的疼痛（ NRS為0至10 ）。預先指定的最小臨牀重要差異為1.7分。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Between November 2021 and June 2024, 90 patients were randomly assigned (45 per group). The mean age was 58.1 years, and 89 participants completed the 12-month follow-up. At 12 months, the observed mean walking-related pain was 1.3 in the arthrodesis group and 5.7 in the watchful waiting group (adjusted mean difference, -5.0 points [95% CI, -6.1 to -3.9 points]), exceeding the prespecified minimal clinically important difference and favoring arthrodesis.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年11月至2024年6月期間，隨機分配了90名患者（每組45名）。平均年齡為58.1歲， 89名參與者完成了12個月的隨訪。在12個月時，觀察到的平均行走相關疼痛在關節置換組中為1.3 ，在觀察等待組中為5.7 （調整平均差異， -5.0分[95 ％ CI ， -6.1至-3.9分] ） ，超過預先指定的最小臨牀重要差異並有利於關節置換。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Single-center design.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Among adults aged 40 years or older with painful hallux rigidus, first MTPJ arthrodesis provides a superior and clinically significant reduction in walking-related pain at 12 months compared with watchful waiting.
abstract.textZh: 在40歲或以上患有腳趾僵直疼痛的成年人中，與觀察等待相比，第一次MTPJ關節融合術在12個月時提供了與行走相關的疼痛的優越和臨牀顯著減輕。

articles.title: How Would You Manage Perioperative Cardiovascular Risk for Noncardiac Surgery in This Patient With Complex Comorbidity? Grand Rounds Discussion From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
articles.authors: Libman H, O'Glasser AY, Fleischmann KE, Kanjee Z

abstract.text: Perioperative cardiovascular management involves the assessment and identification of risks in patients undergoing surgery, as well as development of a plan for mitigation of those risks during and after the procedure. It includes risk stratification, which provides guidance for preoperative testing and perioperative management in patients at high risk while avoiding overscreening in those at low risk. Specific guidance is informed by the patient's medical comorbid conditions, functional capacity, and type and urgency of planned surgery. In 2024, the American Heart Association, the American College of Cardiology, and other professional organizations published a comprehensive set of evidence-based recommendations for the evaluation and management of cardiovascular risk in adults undergoing noncardiac surgery. Its methodology included systematic literature review, multidisciplinary expert consensus, and peer review. Here, 2 experts in this field, a general internal medicine physician and a cardiologist, debate how to manage the case of an 80-year-old man with multiple cardiopulmonary conditions and other organ system comorbidities who is scheduled to undergo extensive skin cancer surgery. They discuss how to approach preoperative evaluation of such a patient with a focus on optimizing his status and monitoring for cardiac complications during and after the procedure.
abstract.textZh: 圍手術期心血管管理涉及評估和識別接受手術的患者的風險，以及制定在手術期間和之後減輕這些風險的計劃。 它包括風險分層，為高風險患者的術前測試和圍手術期管理提供指導，同時避免低風險患者過度篩查。 具體的指導取決於患者的醫療共病狀況、功能能力以及計劃手術的類型和緊急程度。 2024年，美國心臟協會、美國心臟病學會和其他專業組織發表了一套全面的循證建議，用於評估和管理接受非心臟手術的成年人的心血管風險。 其方法包括系統文獻審查、多學科專家共識和同儕審查。 在這裡，該領域的2位專家，一名普通內科醫生和一名心臟科醫生，討論如何處理一名80歲的男性患有多種心肺疾病和其他器官系統合併症的病例，他們將接受廣泛的皮膚癌手術。 他們討論如何進行此類患者的術前評估，重點是優化其狀態並監測手術期間和之後的心臟併發症。

articles.title: Diagnostic and prognostic outcomes for men with prostate cancer detected through opportunistic, asymptomatic PSA testing or symptomatic presentation to primary care: The PC3 cohort study
articles.authors: Merriel S, Nickol P, Abel GA, Hamilton W

abstract.text: Background Primary care is the main route to diagnosis for patients with prostate cancer, either following asymptomatic Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) testing or investigating prostate-related symptoms. Whilst previous primary care studies suggest an association between symptoms and prostate cancer diagnosis, it remains unknown whether outcomes differ based on the presence or absence of symptoms. Aim To compare prostate cancer stage, grade, and mortality amongst symptomatic patients presenting to primary care with asymptomatic patients. Design and setting Retrospective cohort study using Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum. Included adult males aged 50 years and above with first presentation to primary care for coded lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS), haematuria, or erectile dysfunction between 01/01/2011 and 31/12/2016 with up to two asymptomatic males matched by age, ethnicity, and GP practice. Method Main outcomes: Clinically significant prostate cancer (Gleason Grade Group ≥ 3); Early-stage prostate cancer; Cambridge Prognostic Group; prostate cancer mortality; all-cause mortality. Mixed effect logistic regression modelling was performed. Results 722,597 males were included (262,178 [36.3%] had coded symptoms). Mean age was 64.4 years (SD 9.76). 90.68% identified as White ethnicity. 12,297 new prostate cancer diagnoses within 24 months of index consultation (8,101 [65.88%] in symptomatic group). Clinically significant prostate cancer (Adjusted OR 1.14 95% CI 1.07, 1.23) was more likely in the symptomatic group. No difference was found in stage at diagnosis (aOR 1.02 95% CI 0.95,1.09). Conclusion Investigating symptomatic patients in primary care is more likely to detect clinically significant prostate cancer with no difference in stage at diagnosis.

articles.title: Understanding chronic pelvic pain in women survivors of sexual violence: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Mccarter C, Williams ACC

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Chronic pelvic pain (CPP) affects an estimated 14.8% of UK women. Survivors of sexual violence are more likely to experience CPP, but the relationship is complex and underexplored. Shame and stigma from both experiences may interact and influence help-seeking.
abstract.textZh: 慢性骨盆疼痛（ CPP ）影響估計14.8 ％的英國女性。性暴力倖存者更有可能經歷CPP ，但這種關係複雜且未得到充分探索。來自這兩種經歷的羞恥和恥辱可能會相互作用，並影響尋求幫助。

abstract.label: AIMS
abstract.text: To broaden understanding of how women survivors of sexual violence make personal meaning of CPP, and to consider clinical implications of findings.
abstract.textZh: 擴大對性暴力女性倖存者如何使CPP具有個人意義的理解，並考慮結果的臨牀意義。

abstract.label: DESIGN & SETTING
abstract.text: A qualitative study of UK community-recruited women who have survived sexual violence and who experience chronic pelvic pain (CPP).
abstract.textZh: 一項針對英國社區招募的婦女的定性研究，這些婦女在性暴力中倖存下來，並經歷慢性骨盆疼痛（ CPP ）。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Ten participants were recruited via social media and engaged in individual, semi-structured online interviews about their experiences and understandings of sexual violence and CPP. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using reflexive Thematic Analysis.
abstract.textZh: 透過社交媒體招募了10名參與者，並進行了個人的、半結構化的線上訪談，了解他們對性暴力和CPP的經歷和理解。訪談被逐字轉錄，並使用自反主題分析進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Three main themes were developed: (1) Healthcare professionals' attempts to silence women, who felt ignored, disbelieved or dismissed; (2) Treating the whole woman, describing the need for integrated, biopsychosocial approaches; and (3) A woman's place is in the resistance, highlighting women's active efforts to reclaim their narratives and pursue care. abstract.text: Young people aged 14-24 years who had been registered ≥6 months were included. Annual rates of new registration per 10 000 person-years at risk (PYAR) and recorded prevalence were calculated, stratified by age, sex, region, and year.

articles.title: Investigating the conditions in which women GPs thrive in general practice: a realist review
articles.authors: Abrams R, Williams V, Park S, Golder S, Goyal A, Whiley L, Jefferson L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women GPs experience higher rates of burnout, anxiety, depression, and slower career progression than men GPs. Women GPs are sought out by patients for specific conditions, which may increase consultation length. This can be a source of job satisfaction for some. However, it can also contribute to additional exhaustion and affects career progression, meaning women GPs are at higher risk of leaving the profession. There is an urgent need to identify solutions to retain and support them.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: This review brings together a wide range of evidence to identify the conditions in which women GPs can thrive, to better support them at work.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: An international realist review of academic and grey literature was conducted across eight databases and Google Scholar.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Following a realist approach, supported by stakeholder and patient involvement, a range of published documents were analysed using a realist logic to identify how, why, for whom, and in what circumstances women GPs thrive at work.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 72 documents are included in this review. Sixteen configurations describe the conditions in which women GPs can thrive. Results cover the following three concepts: patient-facing work; navigating competing roles; and sustainable careers, leadership, and success. However, literature also places heavy reliance on encouraging women GPs to 'fix' their own circumstances.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This review provides evidence-based recommendations that may be of interest to those responsible for organisational culture within general practices, including (but not limited to) GP partners, and women GPs, who can utilise the recommendations to influence change.

articles.title: Association of the NHS Health Check with all-cause mortality: a longitudinal cohort study in primary care
articles.authors: Saund J, Dodhia H, Vanoli J, Masselot P, O'Neill S

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention is a policy priority because of widening inequalities and increasing preventable deaths. The NHS Health Check (NHS-HC) programme aims to promote early detection and prevention of CVD but has a wider-reaching impact owing to targeting multiple risk factors. Although programme evaluations demonstrate improvements in detection and surrogate markers, research on mortality outcomes remain limited, particularly using representative, real-world data.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate the effectiveness of NHS-HCs in reducing all-cause mortality.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Longitudinal cohort study in an inner-city London borough.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data from electronic primary care records were analysed for 158 645 eligible participants (2009-2023). Survival was modelled using a Cox proportional hazards model with time-varying exposure. All-cause mortality risk was compared between those attending ≥1 NHS-HC (n = 42 589) and those who did not (n = 116 056). Sociodemographic, geographic, and behavioural factors were adjusted using propensity score weighting.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 158 645 participants, 63 347 (39.9%) were of Black, Asian, mixed, or other ethnicity, and 100 825 (63.6%) lived in the two most deprived quintiles in England. Attendance at ≥1 NHS-HC was associated with lower mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 0.68, 95% confidence interval = 0.63 to 0.74), indicating a 32% reduction in risk. Ten-year absolute mortality risk reduction increased with age, with the largest difference among those aged 70-74 years (18.1% versus 12.9%). Sensitivity analyses supported these findings.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study suggests significant long-term survival benefit associated with the NHS-HC, supporting continued investment in and optimisation of the programme to provide population health benefits. Findings were robust to missing data assumptions and COVID-19, although residual confounding cannot be ruled out.

articles.title: General practice closures or mergers: a survival analysis of contributing practice
articles.authors: Hutchinson J, Anderson M, Santos R, Kontopantelis E, Sutton M

abstract.text: Background 20% of general practices in the England have closed or merged since 2013. Little is known about factors that are associated with these closures, despite evidence on their negative impacts. Understanding these risks is important for recovering general practice. Aim Describe how differences in the patient mix, practice location, workforce, funding and quality are associated with the future risk of closure Design and Setting Multilevel survival analysis of all general practices in England. Method All practices open on 1st April 2019 were followed until 1st April 2025 or closure. We gathered data on practice population characteristics, workforce, funding and quality. Cox proportional hazards models were used to analyse how these measures were associated with time to closure. Results Practice contract type and geographic location (region and rurality) were key factors associated with closures or mergers. For example, rates ranged from 3.7% to 19.7% by geographic region. Greater risk was associated with smaller practices, with a practice at the 10th percentile (3,032 patients) having 253% (95% CrI: 200%, 312%) higher risk of closure or merger than the median (7,256 patients). Greater risk of closure or merger was associated with losing or failing to gain patients (hazard ratio v medium increase 1.68 (95%CrI: 1.44, 1.96), lower baseline funding, poorer clinical quality, higher socioeconomic deprivation and certain contract types, but not the supply of general practitioners or nurses. Conclusion The practice contract, relevant region, practice list size, funding and quality are key hazards for the subsequent closure or merger of general practices.

articles.title: Talking about online activity and mental health with young people in primary care: A qualitative interview study
articles.authors: Archer C, Linton MJ, Kessler D, Wiles N, Biddle L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Young people - aged 16-24 - are high users of digital technology. Online activity can be both beneficial for mental health and harmful. Appointments in general practice (GP) or primary care talking therapy provide opportunities to discuss online activity and its impact on mental health with young people. Such conversations could have preventive value by increasing awareness of problematic behaviours, identifying risk and suggest safer use strategies. However, little is known about whether such conversations are currently delivered in primary care.

articles.title: Why Primary Care Clinicians use Advice and Guidance: A qualitative study
articles.authors: Faux-Nightingale A, Harrison R, Burton C, Bajpai R, Clarson L, Hadley-Barrows T, Haines J, Helliwell T, et al.

abstract.text: Background Where available, Advice and Guidance (A&G) can enable primary care clinicians to seek specialist input, supporting decision making and avoiding unnecessary referrals. The use of A&G has significantly expanded, accelerated by COVID19 and contractual changes. While A&G is intended to streamline elective care, concerns persist regarding workload shift, variable responsiveness, and system usability. Despite growing policy emphasis, little is known about why clinicians choose to use A&G. Aim Explore the current use of A&G within primary care, focusing on decision making processes which underpin PCCs' (primary care clinicians') decision to use A&G. Design and Setting Qualitative study set in English Primary Care Method Twenty semi structured video interviews were conducted with primary care clinicians purposively sampled for maximum variation. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis within an interpretive description framework, with themes developed collaboratively and refined through discussion with researchers and PPIE contributors. Ethical approval was obtained (REC 333799). Results Four overarching themes encapsulate clinicians' decisions to use A&G: clinical presentation (acuity and complexity), navigating healthcare pathways, previous experiences of A&G, and using A&G to validate clinical decision making. Barriers included delayed responses and uncertainty about inequitable workload distribution. These factors shape how effectively A&G could be integrated into routine practice. Conclusion Primary care clinicians use A&G to support patient care and aid decision-making, but its effectiveness depends on timely, clinically helpful responses. Ensuring responses remain appropriate to primary care remit and capacity will be essential if A&G becomes the main route into elective care.

abstract.text: Forty percent of U.S. adults have obesity, a complex condition determined by genetics, behavior, environment, and other modifiable and nonmodifiable factors. articles.title: Performance Improvement as a Foundational Component of the Clinical Model of Family Medicine: Rationale, Concerns, Ways Forward
articles.authors: Price DW, Cole SZ, Misra S

abstract.text: In August 2025, leaders from family medicine organizations and representative patient stakeholders met for discussions regarding the evolution of the clinical model for family medicine. Performance improvement (PI), long a part of the continuing board certification process, was among the topics discussed. This discussion paper summarizes concerns about PI as commonly currently operationalized and outlines the rationale for inclusion of PI in the clinical model of family medicine. abstract.text: Family physicians should be providing care for hospitalized patients. articles.authors: Keiser B, Cortez K, Hsu C, Stephens KA, Tong ST

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Loneliness has increased in recent years and is associated with poorer physical and mental health outcomes. While much research has focused on older adults, to date there has been limited research into loneliness in young adults who have the highest rates of loneliness. This study explores loneliness rates among subgroups of emerging adults ages 18-25.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A cross-sectional survey was conducted in a large primary-care health system in Washington State.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Out of 243 emerging adult respondents, 136 (56%) reported experiencing loneliness. Bivariate analyses showed no significant difference for racial/ethnic minorities, while women and nonbinary individuals were significantly lonelier than men (P = 0.03), sexual and gender minority (SGM) groups were lonelier than heterosexuals (P < 0.01) and single individuals were lonelier than those in a relationship (P = 0.02). In a logistic regression model (R2 = 0.11), SGM individuals had OR = 2.01 of loneliness compared to heterosexuals (95% CI = 1.09-3.75; P = 0.03) and individuals in a relationship had OR = 0.37 compared to single individuals (95% CI = 0.20-0.66; P < 0.01).

abstract.label: DISCUSSION
abstract.text: These findings show that it is feasible to identify emerging adults with loneliness and demonstrate the need for targeted loneliness interventions in primary care settings to reduce health disparities among this demographic group.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence for Diagnosing Images of Common Skin Disorders
articles.authors: von Kuenssberg Jehle D, Browne MK, Hoffmann HP, Paul KK, Talbott MM, Campbell KM, Linfante AW, Sorensen BA, et al.

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning are increasingly used in dermatology, primarily for diagnosing skin cancer and classifying disease severity. Primary care providers (PCPs) and emergency physicians have higher error rates in diagnosing dermatologic conditions compared to dermatologists. This study evaluates the performance of an AI-driven dermatologic image analytics tool in identifying common skin disorders from classical images used in medical education.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This prospective study analyzed 42 classical images of common skin disorders using the bellePro application (version 2.1.0; BelleTorus Corporation), trained on over 400,000 dermatologic images. A set of dermatologic images used in a national board review course underwent blinding and independent validation by an academic dermatology department. This module provides AI-powered predictions from cell phone photos, ranking them by "image match scores" (higher values indicate better predictions). The primary outcome was the accuracy of three image predictions in identifying known diagnoses, along with the corresponding image match scores.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The AI tool correctly predicted 38 out of 42 skin disorders (positive predictive value was 90.5%) as the top differential on the first attempt for all three attempts. Four conditions (angioedema, squamous cell carcinoma, hand foot and mouth disease, and chickenpox) were included in the prediction differential list each attempt but never ranked first, bringing the total to 42/42 (100%). None of the correctly identified disorders had an average image match score below 0.64. The average image match score for correct diagnoses was 0.896 (SD = 0.098).

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: The findings suggest that this AI-based dermatologic image analytics tool performs effectively on classical images of common skin disorders typically seen in clinical practice. This has potential to serve as an adjunct for providers to improve patient outcomes in environments lacking timely access to dermatology resources.

articles.title: The Future of Patient Panel Size in Primary Care
articles.authors: Strayer SM, Hoff T

abstract.text: Britz et al present an important contribution to the understanding of primary care capacity by identifying all Primary Care Physicians (PCPs) in one state and quantifying their patient panel sizes. Their findings, showing median panels between 1196 and 1290 patients, provide critical insight into how many individuals each PCP can realistically serve amid a national primary care shortage. This commentary explores emerging trends that may reshape how ideal panel size is defined in the future, particularly the increasing integration of non-physician providers, digital health platforms, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Technologies such as ambient dictation, automated order entry, and AI-driven patient messaging can reclaim valuable clinician time and help mitigate burnout, potentially allowing physicians to manage larger panels. Likewise, wearable sensors, virtual visits, and non-traditional care outlets such as retail clinics and urgent care centers offer additional opportunities to expand system-wide capacity. However, these efficiencies must be balanced against current capacity issues in primary care, including potential added monitoring workload, increasing complexity of patients, as well as currently over-burdened primary care practices due to administrative burden and high volumes of patient messaging. Future studies are needed to determine whether these innovations truly expand capacity or simply redistribute effort within the evolving ecosystem of primary care.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Virtual scribe services are increasingly utilized to reduce documentation burden and mitigate clinician burnout. While evidence supports their positive impact on clinician wellness and productivity, the effect on patient experience has not received as much attention. We hypothesized that clinicians using virtual scribes would demonstrate improved patient satisfaction scores due to enhanced face-to-face interaction during visits.

Pre-implementation scores (6 months prior to scribe utilization) were compared to post-implementation scores (months 3-9 with a scribe service) using related-samples Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.

articles.authors: Sanders MR, Fiscella K

abstract.text: This commentary examines the implications of the Community Health Worker (CHW) Access Act introduced by Congress. If passed, primary care practices would be able to receive reimbursement for CHW services. We examine the potential and pitfalls of the Bill and recommend implementation strategies to support the uptake of CHWs into primary care. This commentary aims to inform stakeholders about the Bill's broader impact on primary care and future CHW sustainability.

This study examines the association between the length of care continuity and the usual place of care for minor health problems, focusing on emergency department (ED) use.

articles.title: Should Family Medicine Embrace Community Involvement and Engagement?
articles.authors: Fogarty CT, Misra S, Kessler BA

abstract.text: Family medicine takes a whole-person, contextual approach to patient care, and understanding community context is important. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) definition of community, "a group of people with diverse characteristics who are linked by social ties, shared common perspectives and identity, and engagement in joint action," provides a broad conceptual framework. While community service doesn't have a standard definition, many physicians and residency training programs incorporate such activity into practice and training. Community engagement consists of ten key principles framing public health and programmatic involvement in improving the health of a community. Despite the importance of understanding the community in practice, true community engagement for contemporary family physicians, given panel size, visit volume, and documentation burden, is unrealistic as a core part of the work of most practicing family physicians.

articles.title: International Medical Graduates in America: Navigating a Winding History of Immigration Laws and Licensure Requirements
articles.authors: Chaudhry HJ, Johnson DA, Abraham GM

abstract.text: State legislative initiatives that were started in 2023 to streamline the licensing of internationally trained physicians (ITPs) have garnered bipartisan interest and support across the country. The new approach, more broadly applicable than previous efforts, precludes a requirement for Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education-accredited graduate medical education conducted in the United States. The change is the most recent development in our nation's long and winding history of licensing international medical graduates (IMGs). At the turn of the 20th century, only about 100 IMGs presented to state medical boards each year for licensure. Medical graduates around the world who sought quality postgraduate training opportunities, including those from the United States, looked to Europe. Nativist sentiment and state and federal laws in the 1920s discouraged or prohibited immigration for many internationally educated or trained physicians. That changed substantially during and after World War II when a population surge, an increase in physician refugees, and, later in the 1960s, relaxed immigration laws combined with a robust expansion of hospitals to shift the medical regulatory landscape. The result was greater receptivity to IMGs, with concerns about prevailing credentialing models predicated on recognition by state medical boards of "approved" international medical schools. The establishment of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates in the 1950s mirrored a broader shift toward evaluation of persons and their capabilities. Recent demographic pressures (for example, a growing and aging patient population and a maldistributed and insufficient physician workforce) are prompting a flurry of state legislative initiatives to improve access to care and welcome more IMGs, especially ITPs, in a trend that runs counter to growing federal restrictions on immigrants and international workers.
